data.body:
Root cause confirmed with a 2-clone reproduction (Gerrit change 3301).

- History: the operator COMPACT `c1343e50cd2` has parent `ee354bb4ffe`, which does not contain the MCP TAG_DELTA `2c7a33d9032`. The operator's last merge before the fold was `9441b0f7b85`. The TAG_DELTA arrived through union merge `70bc54fbadb`, after the SNAPSHOT was committed.
- Code: `_fold_under_lock` (`src/rebar/_commands/compact_txn.py`) placed the SNAPSHOT at `max_old + 1` only when a young live event existed. Otherwise it used `hlc.next_tick`, which is the folding host's clock. On 77b6, CREATE and LINK were 46 min old with nothing younger on the operator clone, so the SNAPSHOT landed at fold time and buried the TAG_DELTA, which was 24 s older.
- Reproduction: `tests/integration/test_fold_cross_clone_horizon.py`. Clone A creates and comments at T0. Clone B tags at T0+45m36s and pushes. A folds at T0+46m with a 30 min horizon and `--skip-sync`, then merges. Before the fix: the TAG_DELTA (`4000002736000000001-…`) sorts before the SNAPSHOT (`4000002760000000001-…`). After: it sorts after the SNAPSHOT and replays, and fsck reports no orphan_event. The unit twin is `tests/unit/test_fold_horizon_placement.py`; it failed before the fix (1 of 3) and passes after.
- Fix: under a positive horizon, the SNAPSHOT always goes at the fold boundary (`_snapshot_timestamp`). `horizon<=0` keeps the clock placement.
- Not fixed here: the same placement exists in snapshot rebuild (bug valiant-supreme-erin). The existing 77b6 row needs the operator repair task respirable-trapezial-ekaltadeta. A local `fsck --repair-snapshots --dry-run` plans a rebuild for 77b6 and nothing else.
